## What changes?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the tests or manual checks you ran. For visible changes, include a screenshot; for chess logic, include a reproducible PGN/FEN or relevant test case.

- [ ] Ran `npm test`.
- [ ] Ran `npm run test:smoke` if engine integration changed.
- [ ] Ran `npm run package` and checked the unpacked extension if packaging or browser behavior changed.
- [ ] Updated documentation and third-party notices when needed.
- [ ] Included no private games, credentials, or unrelated generated files.
